title: Train Staff to Verify, Not to Detect
summary: AI-written phishing and cloned voices erased the tells staff were taught to spot.
caption:
The phishing tells your staff were trained to spot are gone. AI writes fluent, specific messages, and voice cloning has carried the problem to the phone.
Detection-based training now teaches a dangerous inverse: a polished request must be legitimate.
The stronger program trains procedure. Payment changes are confirmed through a number already on file. Urgent executive requests are confirmed on a second channel, and executives follow the rule too. Success is measured by how fast people report, not how often they click.
An employee who follows the callback rule defeats a flawless deepfake without ever suspecting it was one.
Our new essay lays out what awareness training should accomplish now, and three questions to ask before renewing it.
